room_rent.note: For SI 3L–10L: 1% of SI up to ₹7,500/day; for SI 15L–25L: 1% of SI up to ₹10,000/day. Proportionate deductions apply on associated medical expenses if higher room chosen.

icu.note: ICU charges covered as part of in-patient treatment; no separate sub-limit stated for Premier Plan.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned for Premier Plan.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; Bariatric capped; Robotic surgery sub-limits
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹25,000–₹50,000 depending on SI. Bariatric: ₹2L–₹3L. Robotic surgeries: sub-limits per procedure category. Newborn: 10% of SI up to ₹50,000. Road ambulance: ₹2,500/hosp, ₹5,000/yr.

deductible.note: No inbuilt deductible. Deductible is not available as optional cover for Premier Plan.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months for 1-year and 2-year policy terms; 36 months for 3-year term as well. No PED buy-back option available for Premier Plan.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for 1-year and 2-year terms; 18 months for 3-year term. Covers cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacements, etc.

maternity.note: Delivery expenses and Assisted Reproduction Treatment are not available under Premier Plan. Newborn baby cover is available subject to conditions.

cumulative_bonus.note: 25% of SI after first claim-free year; 10% of SI for every subsequent claim-free year; max 100%. Bonus reduced at same rate as accrual on claim. Alternatively, No Claim Discount of 4% (SI 3L–4L), 2% (SI 5L–7.5L), 1% (SI 10L–25L) in lieu of CB.

restoration.note: Automatic restoration is not available under Premier Plan.

domiciliary.note: Covered for illness requiring hospitalisation but treated at home for >3 days. Several conditions excluded (asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to sum insured. Yoga & Naturopathy require prior company approval.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor expenses benefit is only available under Signature Plan.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance: up to ₹2,500 per hospitalisation, max ₹5,000 per policy year. Air ambulance not covered under Premier Plan.

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgeries: up to ₹4L–₹7L depending on procedure. Other modern treatments (immunotherapy, stem cell, intravitreal, deep brain stimulation, etc.) subject to sub-limits (e.g., 30% of SI for several categories).

consumables.note: Consumables cover (List I items) is not available under Premier Plan as inbuilt or optional.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit is India only. No international cover available.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, claims cannot be contested except for proven fraud.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes.

notable_exclusions: No maternity/delivery, no ART/surrogacy, no organ donor expenses, no air ambulance, no restoration, no consumables, no home care treatment, no hospice care
